detail: Coromandel International Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the NSE under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires any person who has acquired shares or voting rights crossing 5% or any subsequent slab (10%, 15%, etc.) to disclose such acquisition within two working days. The disclosure itself does not reveal the acquirer identity, shareholding quantum, or consideration without access to the filed document; the PDF reference suggests this is an official NSE filing.
